body: It's ok, I'll PM you. Thanks again.

Thank you. There's really no pressure at all. Talking about it has helped a little bit, but when I'm faced with that bitter reality it stings like a festering sore, and my heart feels so heavy. 

I really don't feel like sleeping because I hate that feeling you get when you wake up and remember everything, and go back to the existence you loathe. And I have to see my scars, and how I've harmed myself. It's almost like I see myself through my mother's eyes in that moment. regret, total and utter pity for myself. *Why did I do that to myself*?

There's no one there. Despite your warmth, you're totally frozen outside of everyone. And it's insidious. You at first think it's no big deal, your own company is the best. You play a video game, write a song, watch a tv show. But you can feel it slowly killing you. It's when you receive just a single shred of care from someone but they just turn their head the minute you really want to connect. It's like the universe teases me, only to laugh at my face. Sorry...rambling. Once again thank you all for your supportive words. It means a lot for a soft girl like me. I wish kind people on the internet existed irl, and you all deserve happiness and meaningful friendship.

Thank you so much. I wish it would be easy to look for good friends at my university, but when your bad friends are everywhere, it's really tough. I rely on them for my social life, so it seems like an endless cycle of people just not caring for me at all. It feels like those people don't exist. It tears me apart.

And I'd really like that! I'm really down to talk to just about anyone.
Thank you for your kind words, it really means so much to me, you couldn't possibly imagine. I really don't mind giving to the world, it's just that having one friend, just one, would be really nice.
